snippet.title: Tetra Rise - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4208050/Tetra_Rise/?utm_source=youtube

Tetra Rise is an action-platformer with roguelite elements, where you upgrade your equipment and face ever-growing hordes as you climb toward the surface.
